access_links.label: Electricity demand on the openmod wiki

description: online database is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Electricity demand > Singapore", published or maintained by ema.gov.sg (publisher inferred from the link). Singapore's Energy Market Authority has provided an online database with half-hourly demand, downloadable per month from the year 2004 onwards. Data is available in csv format or as pdf. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Electricity demand" lists it under "Singapore". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
licence: not stated on the wiki page (source page not read)
